title: ABOUT THE AUTHOR
text: ABOUT THE AUTHOR Drew Magary is a correspondent for GQ magazine, a columnist for Deadspin , and a Chopped champion. He’s also the author of three other books: The Postmortal , Someone Could Get Hurt , and Men w ith Balls . This is his second novel. He lives in Maryland with his wife and three children, and enjoys taking long walks. Find Drew on Twitter @drewmagary
